An AI platform for hotel & resort sustainability

Where sustainability also means savings.

EcoServe turns your hotel's food, water, and energy data into two clear numbers: how efficiently you're running, and how much that efficiency is worth. No more guessing where the waste is.

See how it works Estimate your savings

Most hotels only see the total.

Every day, hotels and resorts move through enormous amounts of food, water, and energy. What lands on the utility bill is a single number — not where the waste happened, why it happened, or what to do next.

Right now, sustainability in hospitality runs on manual checks, occasional reports, and general advice. It helps, to a point. It doesn't give managers the clarity to catch problems early, plan ahead, or see how eco-friendly choices affect the bottom line.

How it's handled today

—Manual checks, done on a schedule, not continuously
—Occasional reports that summarize what already happened
—General advice that isn't specific to your property
—Environmental effort and cost savings tracked separately, if at all

With EcoServe

✓Continuous data, from manual entry or connected systems
✓Predictions based on occupancy trends, updated as you go
✓Specific, practical suggestions for where to cut waste
✓One score for efficiency, one for what it's saving you

Three steps, running quietly in the background

Set it up once. EcoServe keeps working as your occupancy and usage change.

01

Connect your data

Bring in occupancy, food use, electricity, water, and waste — enter it directly, or connect smart meters, IoT devices, and your hotel management system.

02

Let EcoServe do the analysis

AI predicts what you'll need based on occupancy trends, flags usage that looks off, and suggests practical, specific ways to cut what's unnecessary.

03

Track what changes

Watch your EcoScore and Savings Score move over time. Generate sustainability reports and a guest-facing profile automatically, without extra work.

Starting in Sri Lanka, built to travel

EcoServe launches first with hotels, resorts, and boutique stays in Sri Lanka — a real, growing hospitality market where the platform can be tested and refined with actual properties. It's software, so it scales without heavy infrastructure.

Phase one

Sri Lanka

Hotels, resorts, and boutique stays — proving the platform where it can be tested closely.

Phase two

Wider hospitality

Larger hotel chains, restaurants, and serviced apartments join the platform.

Phase three

International markets

Expansion beyond Sri Lanka, with deeper smart meter, IoT, and PMS integrations.

Questions, answered

The things hoteliers usually ask us before saying yes.

No. You can start with manual or spreadsheet data entry on the Boutique tier and connect smart meters, IoT devices, or your hotel management system later, whenever it makes sense for your property.
Your bill shows one total, after the fact. Savings Score attributes savings to specific changes — lower electricity use, less food waste, better water management — so you can see which decisions are actually paying off, not just that the number moved.
Yes — this is a core part of the platform. Usage is compared against what's expected for your current occupancy trend, not a flat baseline, so a busy weekend doesn't get flagged as "waste" the way it would with a simple bill comparison.
It's a shareable page and QR code summarizing your EcoScore and key stats — useful for your website, booking platform listings, or printed in-room, so guests can see your environmental commitment backed by real numbers.
We're onboarding the first group of properties in Sri Lanka now. Request early access below and we'll follow up about timing, setup, and which tier fits your property.
